messages:
mika: quick heads-up 76: PR #468 is ready for review. Changes: small migration guide update for the SDK, plus a tiny tweak to the docs build so local preview doesn't break links. Netlify preview ✅, Vercel preview failing linkcheck.

tom: what exactly is failing on Vercel?

mika: linkcheck job flags a few internal links as external because Vercel rewrites `/latest/foo` -> `/latest/foo/` with a 302. The checker treats follow->same-host redirect as an error.

arun: can we configure the checker to accept 3xx to same host? That's better than hacking docs.

mika: agreed. I opened a follow-up issue but wanted to land the SDK snippet fix today. The snippet in the migration guide had an old Python auth pattern that confuses new users.

tom: can you paste the before/after snippet here?

mika: before: `client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"))` (no session timeout). After: `from redwood import Client\nclient = Client(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"), timeout=5)` and added Rust sample with the new `RequestBuilder` chain.

lina: I can eyeball the snippets. Anything else in this PR that affects build output?

mika: one small change: local dev proxy used to serve site at `/docs/` prefix which broke absolute paths in MkDocs. I changed the dev-run docs script to use `mkdocs serve --dev-addr=127.0.0.1:8000` and updated CONTRIBUTING to hit `/` instead of `/docs/`. That keeps production config untouched.

arun: good, keep production mkdocs.yml untouched. Also please add a short note in the PR about why we prefer the `mkdocs serve` change so reviewers know it's only local.

ci-bot: Vercel preview: pr-468-preview-9 build failed linkcheck step. Netlify preview: pr-468-netlify-success. Local build id: local-802.

tom: we'll need a non-author approval. Lina, can you review the code examples and the tiny docs change? If green, we can merge in the 3pm merge window.

lina: on it, reviewing now. Quick nit: the Rust example uses `client.send().await` without handling errors; add `.map_err(|e| e.to_string())` or an `?` to keep examples idiomatic.

mika: thanks, updated the Rust snippet and pushed. Also added a one-liner in CHANGELOG for the migration guide update.

arun: for linkcheck I can add a rule to ignore same-host 3xx on the checker config in a follow-up PR. Let's not block this user-facing fix.

tom: agree. Lina, anything else?

lina: looks good. Approved.

ci-bot: Reminder: merge window open at 15:00 UTC. Ensure at least one non-author approval and passing CI.

mika: merging now — staging slot passed. Note: created issue to relax linkcheck: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/790.

tom: thanks. After merging, can someone run the local workflow docs smoke test? I can pair if needed.

mika: will do a quick smoke: `mkdocs serve --dev-addr=127.0.0.1:8000` then `curl -I http://127.0.0.1:8000/_static/css/site.css` returns 200.

arun: closing loop: merged and ticket created for linkcheck. Great job shipping the updated SDK examples and keeping local dev flow smooth.
